title: Fedorov Plans Defence Fund for UA Tech
body: Former Ukrainian Defence Minister Mykhailo Fedorov is taking his wartime tech strategy private, per FT. He wants a Western-backed defence fund for Ukrainian startups building cheap AI missiles, battlefield sensors and a more robotised front line, with drones and unmanned systems sent in before infantry. He is also pushing for a think tank to develop new ways to defeat Russia.
